name: Steak fajitas
steps: Slice the beef steak into thin strips and season with salt and cumin.
Get the pan very hot with the olive oil and sear the steak strips fast.
Remove the steak and add the sliced peppers and onion to the same pan.
Cook the vegetables until charred at the edges but still crisp.
Return the steak to the pan and toss together for a minute.
Pile into warmed flour tortillas and serve.
